rules.name: Business Logic — Price Manipulation
rules.description: Detects price manipulation attempts via negative quantities, zero-price items, or modified totals in checkout
rules.query:
let threshold = 5;
business_logic_events
| where business_logic has_any("wstg", "business-logic", "price-manipulation", "fraud")
| summarize count() by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > threshold
